confidence_notes: Shenzhen meal, coffee, and beer anchors follow city price indexes from May–June 2026. Expatistan's October drink data is based on only 55 prices from five contributors. Cocktail and wine estimates use local beer prices as a guide; accommodation estimates are holistic and may vary substantially by season and location.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink estimates use Shenzhen-specific price data. Accommodation estimates reflect general knowledge of Shenzhen as a major mainland Chinese coastal technology hub.
